data.title: PM seeks proof of exam fraud
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has challenged anyone with evidence implicating government members in the local government recruitment examination fraud scheme to submit it to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC), insisting that anyone found guilty will face action regardless of rank.</p>

data.title: Two dive boats seized over coral threat off Phuket
data.description: <p>PHUKET: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered marine authorities to step up enforcement after two diving boats were found moored for several days in waters off Racha Yai Island, in violation of measures designed to protect coral reefs.</p>

data.title: Flash floods hit Phrao after heavy rain
data.description: <p>Heavy rain caused flash floods in Phrao district, Chiang Mai, on Friday night, sending rescue teams to deploy water pumps and move residents' belongings to higher ground.</p>

data.title: Four bodies found in search of unlicensed Jewish cemetery
data.description: <p>Four bodies have been found at a Jewish cemetery in Chachoengsao after more than 40 officials inspected the site, amid concerns three may have been buried after its permit expired.</p>

data.title: Covid-19 wave expected to ease next month
data.description: <p>The Covid-19 outbreak differs from previous waves, but its pattern remains similar to that of influenza, a leading physician said.</p>

data.title: Professors urge quake safeguards
data.description: <p>Thammasat University academics have called for greater resilience and better disaster response as earthquake and climate risks rise.</p>

data.title: Co-payment  scheme in final stretch
data.description: <p>The government has urged beneficiaries of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme to use their remaining entitlements before the programme ends, as cumulative spending has surged to more than 138 billion baht and generated income for nearly 1.2 million participating businesses.</p>

data.title: New water treatment model helps  700 families after Kok metal scare
data.description: <p>A science-based water treatment project is helping communities along Chiang Rai's Kok River cope with heavy-metal contamination.</p>

data.title: Anutin shrugs off debate threats
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns that opposition MPs will use the upcoming budget debate to attack the government, saying parliamentary scrutiny is part of MPs' rights and responsibilities.</p>

data.title: Pakorn calls for reform of sluggish bureaucracy
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt has called for an overhaul of the country's bureaucracy, focusing on efficiency rather than "bureaucratic reform".</p>

data.title: Pakorn calls for more efficient civil service
data.description: Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt has called for an overhaul of the country’s civil service, focusing on efficiency rather than “bureaucratic reform”.

data.title: Troops seize 1m speed pills after clash in Chiang Mai
data.description: More than 1 million speed pills were seized following a brief armed clash with suspected drug smugglers in Chiang Dao district of Chiang Mai on Saturday.

data.title: Child-sex broker linked to 50 victims arrested in Samut Prakan
data.description: Police have arrested a 38-year-old man accused of running an online network that recruited girls under 18 for prostitution, with investigators linking him to more than 50 victims.

data.title: Israeli man first target of new Thai deportation rules
data.description: An Israeli man convicted last month of making threats against the owners of a zoo on Koh Samui has become the first foreigner ordered out of Thailand under new rules governing deportation.

data.title: Torrential downpour alerts for 24 provinces
data.description: Flash floods and inundation are expected across the North, Northeast and East of Thailand through Tuesday, according to the Office of National Water Resources.

data.title: Jewish cemetery in Chachoengsao ‘failed to meet regulations’
data.description: <p>The Department of Provincial Administration (DPA) has clarified that a Jewish cemetery in Chachoengsao was denied renewal of its operating licence after inspections found it failed to meet legal requirements.</p>

data.title: Business leaders say tax hikes on imported EVs urgently needed
data.description: <p>The Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) will urge the government next week to speed up planned excise tax rises on imported electric vehicles (EVs), saying stronger measures are needed to protect the domestic automotive industry.</p>

data.title: ‘No evidence’ linking ministers to exam scandal
data.description: <p>Police investigating widespread fraud in local government examinations have found no evidence linking any minister in the current government to the scheme, saying the claim was based solely on hearsay and lacked credibility.</p>

data.title: Government accused of ‘stalling’ Senate poll probe
data.description: <p>The main opposition People's Party has accused the government of deliberately delaying parliamentary scrutiny of the Election Commission's (EC) handling of alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Thai army chief returns from US talks
data.description: <p>Weapons development was among the key topics of talks with US military officials during a recent visit by army chief Gen Pana Claewplodtook to strengthen military cooperation between the two countries.</p>

data.title: Israeli embassy denies Phuket sign claim
data.description: <p>The Israeli embassy has denied that a business in Patong, Phuket, displayed a "No Thais allowed" sign, saying the image circulating on social media was manipulated using artificial intelligence.</p>

data.title: 40 govt officials to head to China to study Mandarin
data.description: <p>Forty Thai government officials will leave for China next week for a year-long Mandarin programme aimed at strengthening bilateral ties.</p>

data.title: House set for budget debate this week
data.description: <p>The House of Representatives will meet from Monday to Wednesday to consider the fiscal 2027 budget bill in its second and third readings after an ad hoc scrutiny committee approved spending cuts totalling more than 11.162 billion baht.</p>

data.title: PM delays coalition dinner
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has postponed a dinner with coalition ministers and party leaders that was scheduled for tomorrow, citing important commitments next week.</p>

data.title: Council probes doctor over 30-baht scheme 'insults'
data.description: <p>The Medical Council is reviewing allegations that a doctor insulted a patient and disparaged people using the state's 30-baht universal healthcare scheme, its secretary-general said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Police arrest SK Lucky Nine gang suspect
data.description: <p>A key member of an alleged South Korean investment fraud network known as Lucky Nine was arrested in Nonthaburi on Thursday after spending nearly a year in hiding in Thailand, police said.</p>

data.title: Khon Kaen Hospital reverses deficits
data.description: <p>KHON KAEN: The Ministry of Public Health has hailed Khon Kaen Hospital's turnaround after a decade of deficits as a model for state hospitals, and aims to end severe hospital debt by next year.</p>

data.title: Singaporean fugitive held
data.description: <p>A Singaporean fugitive who allegedly ordered highly toxic substances through the dark web was arrested at a condominium in Bangkok's Bang Khae district on Thursday, with police also seizing crystal methamphetamine, hazardous chemicals and ignition devices.</p>

data.title: A high-stakes gamble for all

data.title: Weekly cabinet talk show starts today
data.description: <p>The government will launch a new weekly programme, Talk With The Anutin Cabinet, today, giving ministers a platform to explain their policies, work and plans directly to the public.</p>
